title: Listen to the Wise and Kind
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The people came before the king
and asked him to be good.
He asked the wise men what to do;
“Be gentle, as you should.”

[Chorus]
So listen, listen, little one,
to those who love you so.
God gives us wise ones, kind and true,
to show the way to go.

[Verse 2]
But then he asked his young friends too;
“Be bossy!” they replied.
He chose harsh words; the kingdom split,
and all the people cried.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now rest your head, my little one,
the day is put away.
Tomorrow, listen the first time,
the Lord is near to stay.

[Chorus]
mood: Walking music. A steady, gentle two-step under the voice, like a young king pacing while he thinks for three days, firm but never hurried. The pulse stays even through each chorus so the child feels the safe, plain rhythm of good counsel. By the last verse the step eases into a slow rock and sinks lower, settling the room.
